title: fix(driver-mongodb): a standalone server's refusal of a hooked write names the missing replica set
body:
Fixes #37991

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用单机版 MongoDB 的部署方：给带元数据前置钩子的对象写数据时，被拒的提示从“去连接串加 retryWrites=false”（照做也无效）变成“这是单机服务器，没有事务，请改成副本集（单节点即可）”，启动时也会先打一条警告。
- 为什么做：数据层可靠性；替单机 MongoDB 的运维人员解决“报错把人指错方向、启动时毫无预兆”的问题。
- 出错会怎样：只改提示文字和启动日志，原来被拒的写入照旧被拒、原来成功的写入照旧成功；有问题可直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

On a MongoDB standalone default store, a write on an object with a metadata `before*` hook (or an aborting `after*` hook) runs in the engine's unit, the unit is a client session in a transaction, and the server answers the first command under it with code 20 "Transaction numbers are only allowed on a replica set member or mongos". For a write the MongoDB Node client rewrites that into "This MongoDB deployment does not support retryable writes. Please add retryWrites=false to your connection string." (`execute_operation.js`, mongodb 7.7.0), which the card measured does not help.

- **The refusal** (`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-standalone-unit.ts`, wired in `mongodb-driver.ts`). Every command the driver sends with a session now carries `.catch(this.unitFault(session))`: a standalone-shaped fault (the server's own error, or the client's rewrite carrying it as `originalError`) becomes `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501, the code this driver already answers for a backend capability gap. The message says the server is a standalone mongod, why the write runs in a transaction, that nothing written inside it was stored, and the fix (a replica set; a single-node one is enough), and says `retryWrites=false` does not help. The client error is kept as `cause`. Every other error, and the same shape on a command with no session, passes through unchanged.
- **At boot.** `connect()` sends one `hello`; with neither `setName` nor `msg: 'isdbgrid'` it logs one `warn` naming the database, the writes that will be refused, and the fix. The objects are not listed: the store connects before any hook is bound, so the line says that, and that the first such write is refused with this cause (the card's "or state why the first write is the right place" branch). A failed probe logs at `debug` and reports nothing.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx`: the standalone sentence quoted the client's hint; it now quotes the new refusal and the boot line.

Why the refusal is not moved to `beginTransaction()`: `startTransaction()` sends nothing, so on a standalone server a unit that sends no command under its session (only carved-out ledger writes, for example) commits today. Refusing at the begin would break it. Mapping at the command keeps WHEN unchanged and changes only WHAT the refusal says. The fork the dispatch named (`supports.transactionsUnsupported` on a standalone store, which would run hooked writes without a unit) is not taken. No engine file and no `packages/spec` file moves.

## Tests

`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-standalone-unit.test.ts` (13 cases). It uses no server: a fake client and Db throw the exact `MongoServerError` instances the client builds on a standalone server. The read gets the server's error, the write gets the client's rewrite.

- Through the wired engine (`ObjectQL` + `bindHooksToEngine`, metadata hooks that do not fail): insert with `beforeInsert`, update with `beforeUpdate`, delete with `beforeDelete` are each refused with `code` `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, `status` 501 and the first sentence. The client's hint is gone, `cause` is the client error, and nothing is stored.
- CONTROL replica set: the same hooked insert is stored inside a committed unit. CONTROL no hook: on the standalone fake, a write on an object that opens no unit is stored and starts no session.
- Pass-through: an E11000 under a session, and the standalone shape without a session, reach the caller as the same reference.
- Boot: standalone `hello` gives one warning (exact text). Replica set member, mongos, and a failed probe give none.

<details><summary>Ablation: mapping removed (`throw session ? refusalForUnitFault(error) : error;` changed to `throw error;`)</summary>

Done with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Anchor x1 to x0, blob 140571bd22dc to 6b0cfc507913, restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

```
 ❯ src/mongodb-standalone-unit.test.ts (13 tests | 3 failed)
     × insert on an object with a beforeInsert hook: refused NOT_IMPLEMENTED/501 ...   (expected undefined to be 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED')
     × update and delete on an object with beforeUpdate / beforeDelete hooks ...     (expected 20 to be 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED')
     × a read under the session (the server's own spelling) is refused the same way (expected 20 to be 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED')
      Tests  3 failed | 10 passed (13)
```

Without the mapping, the insert comes back with the client's code-less hint, which is what the card measured. Update fails first on its prior-row read, with the server's code 20. The 10 controls stay green.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The refusal does not name the object or the hook. The driver only sees a command on a session and cannot know which hook opened the unit. Naming them would take an engine-side wrap at `inAfterAbortUnit` (`engine-hook-dispatch.ts`) and its three write-door call sites. Those are outside this card's file surface, and the driver would need a refusal signal the engine can recognise, which would mean a new code in the spec ledger. The caller still knows which object it wrote, and the message names the hook kinds that open a unit.
- Real-server coverage: `mongodb-memory-server` is opt-in here (#5517), and its default is a standalone server. With `OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED=1`, the existing suite now logs the boot warning once per connect. No assertion reads that log.

## Verification

Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-standalone-unit.ts`: `isStandaloneTransactionFault`, which decides which errors are rewritten.
2. `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-driver.ts`: `unitFault` and `reportStandaloneStore`, plus the 17 `.catch(this.unitFault(session))` sites.
3. `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx`: the standalone sentence.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-mongodb exec vitest run src/mongodb-standalone-unit.test.ts`. Expect `Tests 13 passed (13)`.
